headline: Meta Releases Open Weights for Muse Spark, an 816B Model
dek: The model trained for coding and agents is live on Together AI and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Meta opens a formerly closed model
body: Meta released open weights for Muse Spark Open, a model that until now ran only inside the company's own services (Hugging Face).
According to Meta, it has 816 billion parameters, 42 billion active per token, and takes text, images, audio and video.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: How the model works
s3.body: Per Meta's technical writeup, it uses a mixture of experts and focuses on coding.

points.t: Picks 8 of 256 blocks for each token (Hugging Face).
A 1-million-token window, enough for a whole codebase (Hugging Face).
Trained to read repos, debug and call tools (Hugging Face).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Where it is available
body: According to Together AI, the API costs $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens.
AWS confirms the model on SageMaker JumpStart, and weights can be downloaded from Hugging Face (AWS, SiliconANGLE).

items.t: A launch partner with API access from day one, the company says.
Two variants; the compressed one uses about a quarter of the memory, AWS says.
Follows the 30B Muse Glimmer released in August (SiliconANGLE).

caption.hook: Meta released open weights for Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter model trained for coding and agents.
body: According to Meta, the model uses 42 billion active parameters per token, takes text, images, audio and video, and has a 1-million-token context window.

Together AI says its API costs $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens. AWS confirms the model on SageMaker JumpStart in two variants, and the weights can be downloaded from Hugging Face. It follows Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter model released in August.
caption.cta: Would you build a coding agent on an open model like this?
